method: One pinned native relay owner on a background thread, 16 classified AF_UNIX streams, flat queue, 24 events per poll, 128 per callback, one binary per instrumentation mode and equal 512 KiB scratch. Adaptive policy uses 512 KiB on previously bulk-classified guest downloads only when 1 or 2 events return with capacity >2, an ordinary read hint exceeds 256 KiB, and no EOF/error is present. The one-large arm grants only the first eligible read in the sparse poll a larger quantum. All other reads use 256 KiB in both adaptive arms. Each timed sample warms a full wave, then verifies 88 MiB with 2 ready, 16 ready, or a repeating [1,2,3,16,2,1,16,3] wave. Half-closes, reverse data and retirement are verified. Wall rates include local producer, relay, consumer and byte comparison on the same thread. Owner CPU covers relay drains. Untimed builds check exact reads, writes, and bulk bytes ahead of a one-byte reply. Timed samples have no marker or I/O hooks. Four balanced arm orders occur three times per schedule, with the arm order and schedule order randomized across blocks. Intervals bootstrap 12 within-block changes. No live VM, TCP, dispatch or peer measurements.
